test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

She said, ”I called yesterday, but there was no response”.

options.text: She said that she had called the day before, but there was no response.
She said that I called day before, but there was no response.
She said I called yesterday, but there was no response.
She said she called yesterday, but there was no response.

solution:
The correct answer is: **She said that she had called the day before, but there was no response.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb tense changes from present tense (*I called yesterday*) to past tense (*she had called the day before*) in reported speech.
 
• The pronoun "**I**" changes to "**she**" to reflect the person who originally spoke the sentence.
 
• The conjunction "**but**" is retained in the reported speech.
 
• The sentence is reported using indirect speech, meaning it is not enclosed in quotation marks.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: **Incorrect **- Changes the subject of the sentence to "**I**" instead of "**she**".
 
• Option 3: **Incorrect **- Changes nothing from the original sentence.
 
• Option 4: **Incorrect **- Reports the sentence correctly but changes the verb tense to present tense, which is incorrect.
